memory.browseDescription: Browse native features for the selected project user.

memory.discoveryFailedDescription: You can still browse the pages. Check your sign-in and platform connection, then try again.

ov.label: OpenViking
ov.contentDescription: Browse, read and edit native content available to this user.
ov.sessionsDescription: Review conversations and commit them to extract memories.
ov.retrievalDescription: Explore memories with native semantic, text and path search.
ov.tasksDescription: Browse native tasks, including resource imports, Skills and session commits.
ov.experienceDescription: Read Self experiences and their existing trajectory associations.
ov.emptyDescription: There is no data for this selection yet.
ov.error: The request could not be completed
ov.invalidResponse: The service returned an unexpected response.
ov.uncertain: The write may have reached the service. Check its result before submitting again.
ov.permission: You do not have permission for this action.
ov.peerHint: Leave empty for Self. Peer is a native OpenViking identity.
ov.invalidURI: Choose a valid native content path.
ov.name: Name
ov.selectFile: Select a file to read its content.
ov.editHint: Save replaces the stored content. Native replace can recreate a file deleted while editing.
ov.deleteHint: Delete this session and its archives? Already extracted memories are retained.
ov.messageHint: Stores a message in this session; it does not call a chat model.
ov.parts: Structured parts (JSON array, instead of message text)
ov.invalidParts: Enter a JSON array of message parts.
ov.messageInputConflict: Use either message text or structured parts. Clear one before submitting; both inputs have been kept.
ov.commitHint: Archive messages, then extract memories in the background.
ov.keepRecentHint: Choose 0–10,000 messages to keep in the live session. 0 archives all messages.
ov.invalidFilter: Enter a JSON object for the native filter.
ov.searchPrompt: Enter a query to search native content.
ov.cancelTaskHint: Cancellation is cooperative. The task may finish before cancellation takes effect.
ov.resubmitHint: This submits the current session or memory again. It does not resume the original failed task.
ov.resubmitCommitHint: Choose how many recent messages to keep for this new submission. The original task's retention setting is not reused automatically.
ov.reindexFilterHint: Choose an exact memory URI to list its indexing tasks.
ov.selfOnly: Experience statistics are available for Self experiences only.
ov.lineageHint: Associations depend on native experience-read records. No association does not mean no memories.
ov.boundaryHint: OpenViking evaluates access using this user’s native credential.
ov.noTask: The operation returned without a task ID.
ov.invalidOptions: Check the result limit, token budget and content level.
ov.archiveHint: Load by native archive ID, or open the latest commit. Archives still processing or failed may return not found.
ov.toolListHint: Showing up to 50 tool results. Filter by tool name to narrow the list.
ov.eventHistoryUnavailable: This task has no recorded execution history.
ov.contextLevelHint: Context assembly chooses its own content levels; the level filter applies to ranked results.

hindsight.title: Hindsight
hindsight.description: Explore, recall and curate this user’s memory.
hindsight.emptyDescription: Add content or adjust your filters.
hindsight.unavailable: This operation is unavailable from the provider.
hindsight.uninitialized: The mapped native bank is missing.
hindsight.initializeHint: Reading does not create a bank. An authorized update also initializes it when needed.
hindsight.accepted: Submitted. Follow the native tasks below.
hindsight.uncertain: The request may have reached Hindsight. Check tasks or the resource before submitting again.
hindsight.tooLarge: This request exceeds the upload or JSON size limit.
hindsight.responseTooLarge: The response exceeds the 64 MiB limit.
hindsight.name: Name
hindsight.dryRunHint: Validates the template using the native provider.
hindsight.advancedHint: Edit this operation’s native input. The platform supplies the bank and authorization.
hindsight.confirmHint: This changes the selected user’s bank. Review the target before continuing.
hindsight.confirmed: I confirm this action for the current user
hindsight.graphHint: Select a node to inspect it. The graph reflects the current result limit.
hindsight.notFoundHint: The operation may have expired or be unavailable. This does not confirm completion.
hindsight.cancelTaskHint: Cancellation is cooperative; work already in flight may finish. It does not undo saved data.
hindsight.downloadKey: File key from the completed task
hindsight.filterHint: Use the current operation’s query fields; limit and offset are managed by pagination.
hindsight.retainHint: Each document ID is upserted natively. Preview extraction or submit asynchronously.
hindsight.knowledgeHint: These pages belong to this Hindsight bank.
hindsight.noTasks: No task IDs were returned. Inspect the native result.

operations.preview_prompt: Preview an operation's prompts (no LLM call)
operations.dry_run_refresh_mental_model: Dry-run mental model refresh (preview, no persistence)
operations.search_knowledge_base: Hybrid search over knowledge pages (BM25 + vector)
operations.update_knowledge_node: Rename/move a knowledge-base node or update a page's options
operations.cancel_operation: Cancel a pending or in-flight async operation
operations.get_bank_attachment: Fetch an attachment retained inline with a document
operations.download_file: Download a stored file (async export archive)

hindsight.initializeSuccess: Bank initialized. Refresh to load its contents.
hindsight.noPreview: No preview is available for this response. Expand the native response for details.
hindsight.editHint: Editing a fact regenerates its embedding and dependent observations.
hindsight.exportHint: Exports run in the background. Download the archive after the task completes.
hindsight.uploadHint: Files are retained asynchronously. Per-file metadata belongs in files_metadata, in file order.
hindsight.graphEmpty: No graph nodes match these filters.
hindsight.noSelection: Select a record to view its details.
hindsight.readFailed: This read failed. Use retry to request it again.
hindsight.configHint: Edit bank overrides as native fields. Keys absent from the update remain unchanged; use reset to remove all overrides.
hindsight.consolidationHint: Strategies group facts into observation scopes. Preview evaluates routing without saving the draft.
hindsight.batchRetryHint: Batch-parent retry follows native child-task rules; Hindsight validates eligibility.
hindsight.readOnlyOperation: This operation is unavailable from the provider.
hindsight.templateHint: Validate the template with dry run before applying it.
hindsight.waitingHint: Closing stops waiting in this browser; Hindsight may still complete the request.

nativeMemory.title: Native operations
nativeMemory.description: Use the complete native operation catalog for this project user.
nativeMemory.inputHint: Enter native path, query, headers and body. Identity comes from the selected project user.
nativeMemory.uncertain: The write may have reached the provider. Check its state before submitting again.

memoryProject.projectDescription: Create a project, choose its memory provider, and connect your users with App Key and App Secret.
memoryProject.userHint: Choose a connected user to view their native memory.
memoryProject.failed: The request could not be completed. Check the result before retrying.
memoryProject.providerFixed: The provider is fixed for this project.
memoryProject.secretOnce: Copy this App Secret now. It will not be shown again.
memoryProject.confirmRotate: Rotate App Secret? The current secret will stop working.
memoryProject.confirmRevoke: Revoke this credential? External requests will stop working.
memoryProject.integrationHint: Use these headers for native HTTP and MCP. Keep App Secret on your server. Percent-encode userid when it contains non-ASCII or reserved characters.
memoryProject.identityHint: Resolve identity to obtain the native bank_id for Hindsight SDK calls. OpenViking uses the project user identity automatically.
memoryProject.noUsers: No users have connected yet. Users appear automatically when your project receives requests.

memoryAccount.keyHint: Use an account API key to manage projects through the API. Connect your projects with each project’s App Key and App Secret, plus the end-user ID.
memoryAccount.intro: Manage projects, connect Hindsight and OpenViking, and use their native Memory capabilities.
memoryAccount.failed: Sign-in service unavailable. Please try again.
memoryAccount.secretOnce: Copy this API key now. It will not be shown again.

appFlow.intro: Add persistent memory to your AI projects. Create an project, choose a memory engine, and use the API to write, retrieve, and manage memory for each user.
appFlow.providerHint: Each project uses one provider, with separate memory for each user.
appFlow.openviking: Organize context in directories. Browse memory, resources and sessions, with semantic retrieval.
appFlow.hindsight: Organize user memory in banks. Explore facts, documents and mental models, with recall and reflection.
appFlow.stepCredentialsHint: Call Memory from your backend using App Key and App Secret.
appFlow.stepUserHint: Send X-User-Id in your request. Memory provisions the user automatically.
appFlow.stepExploreHint: Select a connected user to open the provider’s memory workspace.
appFlow.userIntro: Users are the end users of your project. Each has a separate memory space.
appFlow.disabledHint: This project is disabled. Enable it in project settings to explore user memory.
appFlow.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the text manually.
appFlow.secretHidden: App Secret is shown only when created or rotated. Rotate it if you did not save it.
appFlow.firstRequestHint: Replace YOUR_APP_SECRET with your saved secret and your-user-id with an actual user ID from your project. After a successful request, refresh Users & memory.
appFlow.credentialsHint: These credentials connect this project’s users. They are separate from account API keys.
appFlow.credentialWarning: This project is disabled or its credential is revoked. Enable it or rotate the credential before connecting.
appFlow.connectedHint: Choose a user to browse, search and manage their memory.

nativeUI.emptyHint: No results. Adjust your filters, or add content and refresh.
nativeUI.memoriesHint: Browse facts, experiences and observations. Open a record to inspect its content and sources.
nativeUI.documentsHint: Inspect source documents, tags and the memories extracted from them.
nativeUI.modelsHint: Living summaries that organize existing knowledge around a specific question.
nativeUI.directoryHint: Select a file from the explorer, or read this directory’s abstract and overview.
